decisions.summary: all.html carries no glossary hover (data-no-glossary), on the grounds that it is about 14 MB and the hover wraps every term at load; recorded by the session as a deliberate choice
decisions.why: Every record page carries the glossary hover today (record.js wrapGlossary; the standing rule 'glossary tooltips for terms', feature 209), the spec carries today's look over, and the GM asked for a single page with 'all of the research' - nothing in request.md removes a reading aid from either form. The reason is performance, and it is unmeasured: the plan states no load time, and its '14 MB' carries no measurement label (13,611,081 bytes on this round's run). A slow wrap is awkward, not impossible (the wrap can be deferred to what is on screen), so none of the three tests for an exception is met; a deliberate deviation the GM did not approve is the GM's to grant.

Note for T17: the withdrawn-text finding (spec-lint.py line 200) embeds a second '{where}:{n}' location in its message, so stripping only the leading prefix lets a line move there read as a new finding - an over-refusal, not a leak; strip embedded locations too.
